newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Q3 real GDP +3.6 pct yr/yr, Q1-Q3 +4.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech Q3 real GDP +3.6 pct yr/yr, Q1-Q3 +4.0 pct.

text.p: Czech third quarter gross domestic product (GDP), in real terms, rose 3.6 percent over the same period in 1995, the Czech Statistical Bureau said on Thursday.
The CSU added that real GDP for the first three quarters of 1996 rose 4.0 percent, after 4.8 percent growth for the same period in 1995.
CZECH GDP Q3 96 Q1-Q3 96 Q3 95 Q1-Q3 95

Note. The CSU did not release a breakdown of figures for the second quarter nor did it say if it had revised any second quarter figures. All figures are subject to revision. All results measure percentage change for period, year-on-year. All percentage changes are in real, inflation adjusted terms.

The CSU changed the methodology for calculating the inflation adjusted real amount in billions of crowns at the beginning of the year. The third quarter and first three quarters figures for 1996 use 1994 as a base, while the 1995 figures use 1989 as a base. The CSU has declined to release the real amounts for 1995 re-calculated using the new methodology.
